sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B is a reasoning-focused fine-tune of Qwen3.5-9B, distilled from responses generated by DeepSeek-V4-Pro in Max Effect mode. The release concentrates its supervised signal on mathematics and STEM problem solving while preserving the efficiency and practical deployability of the 9B parameter class.
